title: Rehearsing in Canada and learning Peterson's difficult trio parts
summary: Sam flies to Canada to rehearse, tours small colleges, and struggles with the written unison parts but takes it as a challenge.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Three folks, you know, shoot man, so after I left, and I start going up to Canada for rehearsals.
Damn, this man sends me tickets to come to Canada just to rehearse, you know, and send me back home, you know.
I said Damn, so we went out on a little trial

tour, you know, start playing some little towns, little schools, colleges and stuff all out west, and stuff, starting getting, started getting because this is quite an experience for me. I never played parts, these kind of parts before, playing things in unison and stuff.
